meta.name: switch-clients
meta.description: Switch between existing customer engagements and triage competing needs. Use when context switching causes confusion; requires engagement records and preserves one client per write.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在多个客户项目之间快速切换并理清谁先谁后
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时服务多个客户,常被来回切换搞得手忙脚乱
copy.tagline_en: Move between multiple client engagements and sort out which needs come first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several clients and lose track when switching between them

howto.what: 在已有的多个客户项目之间切换,并梳理互相竞争的需求。它基于本地已有的客户记录工作,不会凭空编造或新建记录,记录缺失时如实说明;每次写入只涉及一个客户。
howto.when: 当你在已有客户项目之间来回切换、感到上下文混乱时触发;需要有可用的客户记录,若由 @fde 调用则沿用其现有范围。

say.text: 切换到 A 客户的上下文,先读一下现有记录
say.note: 会先读取已存在的客户记录再继续

say.text: 帮我理一下 B 和 C 两个客户各自待办的事
say.note: 梳理竞争需求,每次只处理一个客户

say.text: 客户记录缺失就直接告诉我,不要新建
say.note: 缺失记录报为限制,不初始化

howto.what_en: Switches between existing customer engagements and triages competing needs. Works from existing engagement records, won't invent or initialize them, and reports missing records as a limitation. One client per write.
howto.when_en: Triggers when switching between existing customer engagements causes confusion. Needs engagement records; if called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope.

say_en.text: Switch me to client A's context and read the existing records
Sort out what clients B and C each have pending
say_en.note: Triages competing needs, one client per write

say_en.text: If a client record is missing, say so — don't create one
